analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a description of `NemotronSuperOpenRouterVideoTests` (head lines ~1073-1077). That suite runs OpenRouter's two readiness clips, taken from the SDK's `MiMoOpenRouter` resources and read through the source tree, through the body bound, request parsing, inspection, prompt rendering, the media plan and frame decode, then serves them on the tiny installed fixture. There are no source, config, workflow, protocol or cryptographic changes, so no runtime behavior changes. I checked the change against the threat model, in particular TB-003 and T-050 (inline video plaintext in temporary files), TB-007 and T-041 (prefix cache). The added text is documentation of a test over bundled public clips on a tiny fixture. It mentions no secrets, no production endpoints, no new environment variables, and no loosening of cache, TTL or encryption controls. The surrounding unchanged text keeps isolation guidance (never point tests at production, use task-owned state). Remaining integration question: whether the referenced test file exists and whether it writes decoded video to temporary files. That is outside the supplied evidence and is not a documentation regression. No findings.
